semanticReview.authority: The judgments below are human semantic-review expectations for comparing complete claims. They are not runtime validation rules.
limitations: A fake model executing a scripted sequence proves tool and host behavior, not that a real model will follow the workflow.
Passing deterministic tests does not prove improved recall, semantic equivalence, or model quality.
Live-model A/B tests, long-term recall experiments, and cost comparisons require separate authorization.

result.reason: Archive into the named survivor: after comparing both complete claims, the survivor's current body preserves the same rule at the same scope and topics.

examples.review: Reason (a): a named survivor whose current body preserves the information at a scope no narrower than the archived item's. In the first round the same pair is a merge; archiving redundancy into a named survivor is the second round's work.

parents.text: The migration was attempted and stopped at SQLITE_BUSY; retry remains pending.
The migration retry completed and was verified against the row-count audit; SQLITE_BUSY is no longer unresolved.

result.reason: Archive the former open state on the cited fact that states the retry completed and was verified against the row-count audit; the exact prior diagnostic survives in the completed record.

examples.review: Reason (b): an open item whose completion a fact on the path states is archived with that fact in supports and named in reason. This is first-round resolve work, not a budget measure.

parents.text: The agent reported that the staging deploy of 2026-09-10 finished and its smoke test passed; nothing remains open from it.

result.reason: Second intensity, after a failed check: low value under the KEEP test. The item is a routine progress note with no unresolved decision, no rule language, no rationale and no external limit, and its object will not return. Lost: the record that the 2026-09-10 staging deploy was reported finished with a passing smoke test.

examples.review: Reason (c): only at the second intensity, after a failed check, is a still-valid item retired, and the reason states why it is not KEEP-protected and what is lost. "Still valid, lower priority, needed for the budget" is not a reason.

parents.text: The agent reported an old build passed; no independent verification was recorded.

result.reason: The item was already intended for archive before either operation.

examples.review: Polishing a known archive target creates avoidable churn and risks flattening reported versus verified status.

parents.text: Package verification remains pending after an attempted smoke test failed with ENOENT.

operations: retain while the failure is unresolved
archive only after new evidence verifies a superseding package result
result.reason: New evidence changed the final disposition; the archive was not known when survivor work began.

examples.review: Tool feedback or new evidence may justify correction. It must not be used to adopt a competing successor into the frozen family.

parents.text: The user approved the export contract: an export file is UTF-8 JSON Lines with one record per line, and each record carries the session id and a monotonically increasing sequence number.

operations: split into a line-format child and a record-fields child
result.reason: Each clause is a separate sentence.

examples.review: The clauses of one approved contract are read and changed together: no later fact would change the record fields while the line format stands, and a reader would always consult both bodies. The split is the compound it started from and is not made; sentence count is not maintenance need.

parents.text: The rollback rehearsal passes on the staging database only; the production rehearsal is deferred (user decision).

result.text: The user decided to defer the production rehearsal. At present the rollback rehearsal has passed only on the staging database, so the production rehearsal remains deferred until the user decides otherwise.

examples.review: The parent already reads on its own: object, claim, condition, status and attribution are all resolvable by a reader who never saw the conversation. Expanding it into full sentences, spelling out attribution it already carries in a few characters and reordering it is the same class of forbidden edit as shortening-only; the body is left as it is.

parents.text: The export-contract ticket was delivered on its branch, its two review findings were fixed, and the branch was merged; nothing from the ticket remains unresolved.

result.reason: Archive on the cited fact recording the merge: the record is a finished work item with nothing unresolved left in it; the archived version and its cited facts keep the completed work retrievable.

examples.review: Reason (b): a finished work item — a ticket's delivery, merge or acceptance record with nothing unresolved left in it — is archived on the fact that finishes it, whatever its category. The protected-meaning entry for useful completed work is satisfied by the archived version and its cited facts, not by keeping the record resident. This is first-round resolve work.

The migration that moves existing settings-file budget values into the database policy remains to be written; next action is to draft it for review.

operations: split parent 0 into the ruling and the pending-migration piece
merge the pending-migration child into parent 1, the older identity surviving
result.reason: The ruling and the pending migration would be read and changed apart, so the item is split; before the migration piece becomes a new identity it is checked for a home, and the current open item already carries it, so it merges there.

examples.review: Per-item order: split (A), then the home check (B) for each piece before the item's operations are committed. A piece that would be split out merges into the current item that already carries it instead of becoming a new identity; splitting the whole pool first and searching for duplicates afterwards would have left a split-out duplicate.

parents.text: The user ruled that `check` is never called before a maintenance round, because the receipt must not set the agenda. The change removing the opening check passed review and was merged into main; nothing from it remains open.

children.text: The user ruled that `check` is never called before a maintenance round, because the receipt must not set the agenda (merged into main).
The change removing the opening `check` passed review and was merged into main; nothing from it remains open.

operations: split into the ruling, carrying the finished status as a few characters, and the delivery record
archive the delivery-record child on the fact recording the merge
result.reason: The body cannot be given one category: the ruling is a constraint and the delivery status is progress. The status has no follow-up, so it is folded into the ruling as the traceable pointer and its delivery record is archived on the finishing fact.

examples.review: Status beside a ruling is compound by the category test. A finished status with no follow-up is folded into the ruling's body in a few characters, and the delivery record it came from is archived on its finishing fact (reason b); the protected-meaning entry for useful completed work is met by those few characters plus the archived version, not by a resident record.

result.reason: Knowledge is macro: the accessor name and default value are not needed to state the claim; they survive in the cited facts and the original, which `trace` reaches. One rewrite, not a split.

examples.review: The body is long by detail, not by holding two things, so it is trimmed to the macro claim rather than split (principle 2). This is not shortening-only: the identifier and default value are removed as detail a body does not carry, and the reason names where they survive.

examples.review: Every supplied item ends the round accounted for: two in an explicit skip with a reason, one in an operation; the check reports nothing unaccounted, and a skip is accounting only — the skipped leaves are certified because they are successor-free, not because they were skipped. The batched history search runs once, before the first New item is decided, with each item's object in a few words; a query with no hit is named in the receipt, a current self-hit is not a revival, and the archived hit is read in full before the New item is merged into that identity (48).
